exposure: accuracy of LMP-based estimated delivery date (EDD)
difference between actual delivery date (ADD) and estimated delivery date (EDD)
cohort: The study included 171 pregnant women participating in the Indonesian Birth Cohort Study based in Makassar, Indonesia.
finding: Lower accuracy of LMP-based EDDs and certain delivery modes are associated with an increased risk of adverse events during delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of adverse events compared to vaginal birth.
